Two local corrections are required: revoke Deep consent after downgrade, and remove the wrong Burt attribution in warren-visit. No wholesale rewrite or blanket full-edition rejection is warranted.

narrativeAssessment.form: Story carried by named people and actions: classes, maze race, drunken abandonment and changed laughter, bakery dismissal, awkward closeness, convention escape, diner intervention, research, family reunion, losses and departure. The ethical conflicts remain inside these events; no management/self-help lesson sequence or invented quoted dialogue found.
narrativeAssessment.relationships: Charlie is thirty-two; Alice is his teacher and later lover; Nemur/Strauss are researchers, Burt the lab tester, Fay the painter/neighbor/sexual partner, Matt and Rose the parents, Norma the younger sister. No extra ages or clinical diagnoses are invented.
narrativeAssessment.essential: A coherent open arc from wanting to learn and find friends through altered relationships and return as a researcher. It stops before the decisive research result and ending, as advertised.
narrativeAssessment.core: Adds selection/testing, the Gimpy loyalty dilemma, remembered family violence, social distance, Burt's objection, Matt and Fay while maintaining the same open stopping point.
narrativeAssessment.deep: Adds the laboratory contingency, research finding and its consequences, Algernon's burial, Rose/Norma, Paradise Lost, Alice's stay/departure, the bakery defense, forgotten class, decision for Warren and final flowers request. The reports do not acquire an invented arrival, later institutional life or death.
narrativeAssessment.philosophy: Personhood, scientific objectification, ambition, attachment and Charlie's own hurtful treatment of others are carried by events and competing voices. Intelligence is not a moral reward, and the experiment is not presented as a clinical learning programme.
narrativeAssessment.uncertainty: Matt's rejection remains Charlie's fear; the imagined conference showman's introduction is not made into an actual speech. Recollections/panic are narrated without asserting an invented medical mechanism.
narrativeAssessment.bilingualParity: All 34 pairs preserve events, names, causes and limits. No material RU/EN divergence found; this is parity of the two original retellings, not certification of an official translation.
narrativeAssessment.quotations: No invented diary entry, dialogue or verbatim Keyes quotation appears in the reader. The fictional research name is an identifier, and its result stays inside the novel's experiment.

findings.title: Downgrading retains Deep consent and permits late resume or Deep contents without a new warning
findings.clauseContext: These are legitimate Deep-only clauses, exposed by the failed revocation path; their narrative wording is not the defect.
findings.promisedRUClause: Чтобы прочитать её завершение, выберите Deep и подтвердите предупреждение о спойлерах.
findings.promisedENClause: To read its conclusion, choose Deep and confirm the spoiler warning.
findings.supportLocation: Progress Report 16 supports the outcome that must remain gated; the gating requirement is the review assignment/BRIEF, not a claim by the novel.
findings.reason: endingConsent is set true by acceptance and never cleared in setMode when selecting Core/Essential. In both locales a genuine downgrade from a late screen returns to a shallow cover, but generic Continue immediately restores algernon-buried and Deep without opening spoilerDialog. Selecting Deep after a second downgrade also exposes all late titles without a warning. This violates the explicitly required revocation boundary.
reproduction: Fresh file load in a unique profile: choose Deep and accept the warning.
Choose Core in Contents, then close Contents: the cover is shallow and the saved late ID remains.
Click the generic Continue control: algernon-buried renders in Deep with spoilerDialog.open false.
Choose Essential, then select Deep again: spoilerDialog.open remains false and late titles appear.
findings.minimumSupportedCorrection: Revoke document-local endingConsent whenever an accepted depth change goes below Deep, clear any obsolete pending action, and route subsequent Deep selection, hidden-ID navigation and saved late Continue through guardEnding before changing mode or exposing late titles/body. Retain generic resume labels and reload revocation. No narrative rewrite is needed for FFA-01.
findings.verificationRequired: Repeat the narrow RU/EN downgrade-to-Core/Essential → Continue and Deep-selection cases; require a warning before any late title/body. Cancel and native Escape must leave shallow mode/position and the safe saved label unchanged.

findings.sourceReason: CliffsNotes Report 15 does attribute this information to Burt, explaining the candidate's error.
